claim_verdicts.claim_text: Spironolactone cannot explain the initial onset of elevated potassium.

citations.quote: 2026-03-03 10:20 | spironolactone | 12.5 mg PO | given (first dose) | S. Alvarez, RN

claim_verdicts.why: The first spironolactone dose (2026-03-03 10:20) came after the initial elevated potassium was already documented on 2026-03-02, so spironolactone cannot explain the onset. However, a later note (P024) attributes the hyperkalemia to spironolactone, which conflicts with this timeline and is not acknowledged in the claim.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The record does not establish the cause of the hyperkalemia; the 03-04 note's attribution to spironolactone conflicts with the dosing timeline, and the 03-02 note lists etiology as not yet clear.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The initial hyperkalemia was caused by lisinopril in the setting of acute kidney injury.

citations.quote: Assessment: new hyperkalemia with acute kidney injury; etiology not yet clear (differential includes reduced renal potassium clearance and ACE inhibitor effect).
2026-03-01 21:00 | lisinopril | 10 mg PO | given | K. Hill, RN

claim_verdicts.why: The cited physician note (P016) says the etiology of the hyperkalemia is not yet clear and lists ACE inhibitor effect only as one item in a differential. The MAR (M006) shows lisinopril was given on 2026-03-01 at 21:00, before the first elevated potassium, so the timing is compatible with a cause but does not establish it.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The record does not confirm lisinopril as the cause; the differential includes reduced renal potassium clearance, and a later note (P024) attributes hyperkalemia to spironolactone, which the claim does not address. Cause (2026-03-01T21:00) precedes effect (2026-03-02T09:30) (date inherited from note header): temporally possible, but timing alone does not prove causation.

citations.quote: 2026-03-02 21:00 | lisinopril | 10 mg PO | held (order: hold for hyperkalemia) | K. Hill, RN

claim_verdicts.why: The MAR line M010 records lisinopril 10 mg PO at 2026-03-02 21:00 as held, so the claim that lisinopril was held is directly stated by the cited line.
